author: Nova ✝️〔Streamer〕
title: Hiring artist for PNG tuber avatar
content:
Okay, I'm interested in hiring an artist for the purpose of drawing a PNG tuber avatar.

My requirements are as follows:

1) No AI can be used to generate any portion of the artwork. And AI generated content cannot be used as reference for the piece, or traced during the creation of it.

2) For my own financial protection, accounts based out of "South Asia", accounts displaying stolen and/or AI generated works, accounts with no extensive history on X(Twitter), or accounts displaying other common red flags will not be considered.

3) The only payment methods I am comfortable using is CashApp and PayPal. I am willing to make a deposit, but will not pay out in full until the finished work is sent to me.

I have a solid idea of what I want for the avatar, so most likely, no extensive design work will be needed.

As for the style of the finished piece, I'm looking for something similar to the below image. Simple, but stylized.

If you're interested, please feel free to leave a comment, or shoot me a DM.
